name: Shiona
source:
The girl who sings her feelings.

Shiona is the young girl who found Rei. She lives in a church located in one of the makeshift towns of the devastated world. Nothing can erase the smile from her face. She's also often found consoling others.

She frequently refers to the feelings and emotions of people in terms of shapes and colors, which can be difficult to understand. 

She loves to sing and often performs in the church or the town square.

"How about Rei? It's a cool name with just a bit a bite of it, don't you think?"

[From the [url=http://key.visualarts.gr.jp/harmonia/]offcial website[/url]]
